note: Raiffeisenbank (АО «Райффайзенбанк»), which calls itself one of Russia's largest banks, was read: its tariffs for current accounts and bank cards (the current product line), in force from 19 October 2026, a PDF with no text layer read by eye, and its debit cards page. For the Cashback card «Мир» (the first column, with the payment sticker and the Mir Supreme cards): opening the account and the card's yearly fee are not charged, and the monthly account fee is charged only on balances in foreign currencies (dollars from 10,000, euros from 5,000 and others), not on a rouble account, so the account costs nothing to keep. Withdrawals at the bank's and its partners' machines are free (the partners aren't modelled); another bank's machine or branch costs 1% of the sum, at least 100 roubles, which the form, holding a fixed sum per withdrawal, doesn't take. A payment abroad in a currency other than the account's costs 2.00% of the sum (the debit fx). Transfers to others at other banks through the Faster Payments System in Raiffeisen Online are free below and above 100,000 roubles a month (domestic 0); at a branch they cost 2% (200 to 3,500 roubles), not modelled. Cards may be issued to clients from 14 (opening from 14). The bank pays no interest on the balance ('Проценты на остаток денежных средств на счете не начисляются'); the form's interest takes a rate above nothing, so it is left out. The fee on inactive accounts (the balance, at most 500 roubles a month) falls only on an account the bank deems inactive, a condition the game doesn't track, and isn't written. Sber, VTB, T-Bank, Alfa-Bank and most other Russian banks didn't answer this client or ended in a Russian root it doesn't trust (2026-10-30), so Raiffeisenbank is the one bank written.
